meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein acne aur oily skin ke liye **₹700 ke andar** kai acche serums available hain. Acne ke liye sabse best ingredient **Salicylic Acid (BHA)** ya **Niacinamide** maana jata hai, kyunki yeh pores ko saaf karke excess oil ko control karte hain.

Aapke budget ke andar kuch behtareen options yeh rahe:

Yeh serum active acne, whiteheads aur blackheads ke liye ek **highly trusted option** hai jo deep pore exfoliation karta hai.

Isme salicylic acid ke sath **Zinc PCA aur Ceramides** hain jo acne ko control karne ke sath skin barrier ko bhi protect karte hain.

Yeh lightweight serum acne treat karne ke sath-sath **Cica extract** ki madad se skin ki redness aur irritation ko bhi soothe karta hai.

Ek simple aur powerful water-based formulation jo **congestion aur blemish-prone skin** ke liye kafi popular hai.

Isme encapsulated salicylic acid use hota hai jo skin par **gentle tarike se kaam karta hai** aur irritation kam se kam hoti hai.

Yeh serum **Salicylic Acid aur Niacinamide** dono ka combination deta hai, jo active acne ke sath-sath purane daag-dhabbe hatane mein bhi madad karta hai.

Isme BHA ke sath **Tea Tree Oil aur Aloe Vera** ka blend milta hai jo oily skin ke liye kafi refreshing aur calming hai.

Yeh active breakouts aur clogged pores ko target karta hai aur isme **Witch Hazel** bhi shamil hai jo pores ko tight karne mein help karta hai.
